card.name: Digits inside years and citations
card.fires_on: Digits and punctuation inside numbers, mostly years like 2009 or 2013, and reference numbers such as volume:page citations or court cases. It fires just before the next digits of the number.

modes.label: Inside year numbers
modes.description: The first or second digit of a 2000s year, or the comma or quote just after a year.
modes.example: THE 2009 NOBEL PRIZE IN PHYSICS THE 20<<0>>9 NOBEL PRIZE IN PHYSICS

modes.label: Citation numbers
modes.description: Colons, parentheses or spaces right before page or volume numbers in references.

modes.label: Counts and dates
modes.description: A space or digit inside a large count or a date.

card.writes: It seems to push toward more digits and away from era or word-like continuations, with a weak, mixed effect.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a year, date or citation number where more digits are about to follow.
